name: Future Ready Scholars at the University of Michigan
org: Michigan Engineering Zone, University of Michigan College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on the U-M Ann Arbor campus solving real problems with the engineering design process. You also build math, reading, writing and study skills. Monthly Saturday sessions follow.
who_can_apply: High school students in Southeast Michigan who like science, tech, engineering or math.
duration: A 2 week residential summer camp (July 5 to 17 in 2026), then monthly Saturday sessions.
deadline_text: 2026 camp: July 5 to 17, 2026. The application was due April 5, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: When the form opens, fill out the Future Ready Scholars form on the program page. The MEZ home page also has a sign-up form for news about the program.
notes: The program page says the summer camp is on the Ann Arbor campus, and the MEZ home page calls it a 2 week residential camp. The Michigan Engineering Zone is in Detroit (3663 Woodward Ave). Questions: mezdetroit@umich.edu.
